dedupe_keys.name: georgia commercial recycling directory and map recyclers processors brokers and manufacturers using recovered materials in the us state of georgia

description: This directory lists the companies that handle recovered materials in the US state of Georgia. It is provided by the Georgia Recycling Coalition together with the Center of Innovation for Energy of the Georgia Department of Economic Development, to help divert materials from landfill. It covers commercial recycling businesses that sort, collect, process and broker recovered materials, and manufacturers in Georgia that use recovered materials in their products; local government drop-off sites are not included. The entries are shown on a free online map, and the data and their sources are kept in a public GitHub repository, with businesses adding and updating their own listings through a web form. Caveats: no licence is stated, entries are self-reported and may be incomplete, and the README does not give the number of businesses or the fields. Coverage is the state of Georgia, United States. Simulation uses: locating recycling and processing capacity for material flow and waste network models, and screening recycling facilities for hazard exposure. Related records: the CalRecycle waste characterization data (data-calrecycle-waste-characterization) describe what is in the waste stream in another US state.
